verdict.rationale: Slate is a terminal coding agent, and a public programmatic API is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only an interactive TUI/CLI: slash commands, hotkeys, and a permissions-bypass flag. There is no documented public API, SDK, or headless programmatic interface, and probes for an OpenAPI/Swagger spec all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
